questions.q: In the Christian faith, which of the following best describes the meaning of 'Service'?
options: Forcing others to work for you without pay
Selflessly using your time, energy, and talents to work for God and help humanity
Attending church only on special occasions
Seeking public recognition for doing minor tasks
questions.explain: **Service** involves dedicating oneself to the well-being of others and fulfilling God's purposes on earth, characterized by humility, selflessness, and dedication.

questions.q: According to Genesis 41:37-57, how did Joseph render a great service to Pharaoh and the nation of Egypt?
options: He built the first pyramid for Pharaoh.
He led the Egyptian army to conquer Canaan.
He accurately interpreted Pharaoh's dreams and successfully managed the nation's food supply during the seven years of famine.
He taught the Egyptians how to read and write.
questions.explain: Joseph provided invaluable service by interpreting the dreams about the impending famine and devising an agricultural strategy that saved Egypt and surrounding nations (**Genesis 41:37-57**).
questions.exam: BECE CRS: Christian Religious Studies: Old Testament (Paper 1)
questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies

questions.q: How did Ruth demonstrate exemplary loyalty and service in the Bible? (Ruth 1:7-18)
options: By leaving her mother-in-law, Naomi, to find a richer husband
By clinging to Naomi and choosing to serve her and the God of Israel even in poverty
By betraying the Israelites to the Moabites
By stealing grain from Boaz's field
questions.explain: In **Ruth 1:16**, Ruth refused to leave Naomi, saying, 'Where you go I will go... your people shall be my people, and your God my God,' showing deep loyalty and service.

questions.q: What major lesson can Christian youths learn from the service of Joseph and Ruth?
options: That serving others always makes you popular immediately
That you should only serve those who are wealthy
That faithful, selfless, and dedicated service ultimately brings God's reward and blessings
That working hard is unnecessary if you pray enough
questions.explain: Both Joseph and Ruth started from positions of hardship, but their **faithfulness and dedicated service** eventually resulted in great promotion and divine blessings.

questions.q: According to Apostle Peter's teaching in 1 Peter 2:18, how should servants conduct themselves toward their masters in the course of their service?
options: With all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust
By obeying only the masters who pay them highly
By constantly rebelling until they are promoted
By doing exactly the opposite of what they are told
questions.explain: **1 Peter 2:18** commands: 'Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.'

questions.q: 1 Peter 2:19-21 indicates that in a life of God's service, enduring sorrow while suffering unjustly is ____________.
options: a sign of God's curse
a gracious thing in the sight of God
proof of weak faith
a reason to abandon the Christian faith
questions.explain: **1 Peter 2:19-20** teaches that if one suffers for doing good and endures it patiently, this is a **gracious thing in the sight of God**, following the example set by Jesus Christ.

questions.q: In Genesis 39:7, what major problem or temptation did Joseph encounter while faithfully serving as an overseer in Potiphar's house?
options: The temptation to steal gold from his master's safe
Seduction by Potiphar's wife
Bribery by the king's cupbearer
The temptation to worship Egyptian idols
questions.explain: **Genesis 39:7** records that after a time, his master's wife cast her eyes on Joseph and said, 'Lie with me,' presenting a major test of **seduction**.
questions.exam: BECE CRS: Christian Religious Studies: Old Testament (Paper 1)

questions.q: How did Joseph successfully overcome the problem of seduction in Potiphar's house?
options: He accepted it to avoid losing his job.
He reported her immediately to the local police.
He flatly refused, stating that it was a great wickedness and a sin against God, and eventually fled.
He bribed her to keep quiet.
questions.explain: Joseph rejected her advances, saying, 'How then can I do this great wickedness and sin against God?' (**Genesis 39:9**), and when she caught his garment, he **fled**.

questions.q: In contemporary society, which of the following is considered a significant problem that hinders sincere service to humanity and the nation?
options: Punctuality
Honesty
Bribery and Corruption
Dignity of labour
questions.explain: **Bribery and corruption** are severe modern problems that destroy the integrity of service, where individuals use positions meant for service for selfish gain.

questions.q: As a reward for his honest and spirit-filled service to Egypt, what did Pharaoh do to Joseph in Genesis 41:39-41?
options: Pharaoh gave him money and told him to return to Canaan.
Pharaoh promoted him to be in charge of his house and over all the land of Egypt.
Pharaoh freed him from prison but banished him.
Pharaoh made him the chief military commander to fight the Assyrians.
questions.explain: Pharaoh **promoted Joseph**, setting him over all the land of Egypt as the second-in-command due to his wisdom and the Spirit of God in him.

questions.q: Besides physical promotion, which of the following is generally noted as a divine reward for dedicating one's life to God's service and keeping His commandments?
options: Unending financial crises
Shortness of breath
Long life and peace
Guaranteed political victory
questions.explain: The scriptures often promise that faithfully serving God and obeying His commandments brings blessings such as **long life**, peace, and divine favor (e.g., Proverbs 3:1-2).

questions.q: A believer facing challenges like bribery, corruption, or seduction in their place of service should remember that true service is ultimately rendered unto ____________.
options: themselves
their direct supervisors only
God
the government alone
questions.explain: Christians are taught to view their service and daily work as being done 'for the Lord and not for men' (Colossians 3:23), meaning their ultimate accountability is to **God**.

questions.q: Joseph wearing Pharaoh's signet ring, fine linen, and gold chain (Gen. 41:42) signifies that God rewards faithful service with ____________.
options: spiritual pride
oppression of the poor
promotion, honor, and authority
the right to take revenge
questions.explain: The royal gifts and elevation of Joseph visually and literally symbolize God rewarding faithful, diligent service with **promotion, honor, and authority**.
